No construction observed yet, but Lyra Storage COD is 2026-11-12 (imminent) suggesting the infrastructure cluster is well-advanced. Paper project is very unlikely given IA, PUCT CCN, and companion projects; but construction not confirmed to have started as of Jul 2026.
